answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense on Nibbit, then Tidal Barrage on Nibbit while Exhausting Send the Runner, then Coral Guard.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Coral Guard with All Streams Flow to the Sea for 9 more damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 9 damage in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 12-damage attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have replaced Coral Guard with All Streams Flow to the Sea.
